summary: This is a routine Form 6-K furnished by NeuroSense Therapeutics Ltd., a foreign private issuer, to report a press release disclosing positive biomarker findings from its Phase 2 proof-of-concept study of PrimeC in Alzheimer's disease. The filing contains no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or management change. It is simply a periodic progress report on clinical trial results, with no corporate action or transaction. The registrant's role is that of a filer providing routine disclosure under the Exchange Act.
